channel.name: BBC Two NL

channel.desc: Colin Murray and Edith Bowman explore Ballycastle's famous Ould Lammas Fair and find out how Venezuelan street food made it to Northern Ireland. They discover how to make money go further when it comes to meat, and Colin introduces Edith to Yellowman and dulce. Chef Julie Lin digs deep to reveal some myths about frozen food, and food journalist Leyla Kazim joins fishermen off the Cornish coast in search of sardines.

channel.name: BBC Two NL

channel.desc: Michael's exploration of Essex is drawing to a close. He visits Colchester, which was first mentioned in AD77 and proudly claims to be Britain's oldest recorded town. He finishes his tour of Essex by driving an old Intercity 125 high speed train.

channel.name: BBC Two NL

channel.desc: Catching rays is a challenge with a sting in the tail. Xav has to find a way to keep Friday the turtle out of trouble. Plus, Freyja gives some care home residents a moving close encounter with sharks.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Antiques Roadshow
channel.desc: Michael Aspel and the team visit Ipswich. Among the items brought to light are a collection of pre-historic spearheads, an early American flag, a silver tankard and a pair of spectacles worn by Napoleon. There's also the latest in the quest to find the UK's champion collector, including a man with 5,000 Dinky toys.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Flog It!
channel.desc: Paul Martin is in the Suffolk countryside at Glemham Hall, which dates back to the Tudor era. Antiques expert David Fletcher discovers some scripts from the television series 'Lovejoy', and Jonathan Pratt spots some Beatles bobbing head dolls.

channel.desc: Dr Janina Ramirez turns detective and heads to Egypt to uncover the real story of how Howard Carter unearthed a pharaoh's tomb when everyone else believed there were no more great Egyptian finds to be made. She discovers that some of Tutankhamun's treasures are missing and reveals the name of the person responsible. She delves into the origins of the supposed pharaoh's curse, and finds the truth about the king's brutal injuries.

channel.desc: Carrie White is a shy young girl who doesn't make friends easily. After her classmates taunt her about her horrified reaction to her totally unexpected first period, one of them takes pity on her and gets Tommy Ross, her boyfriend and class hunk to invite Carrie to the senior prom. Meanwhile, another girl who has been banned from the prom for her continued aggressive behaviour is not as forgiving. Based on the book by Stephen King.

channel.desc: Airing weekends, "American History TV" offers programming about people and events that document the American story, geared toward history aficionados. Topics covered include the Civil War, presidents and the exploration of historical sites.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: Book TV
channel.desc: This long-running staple of the C-SPAN2 weekend schedule helps expand the channel's programming beyond politics. Most episodes of "Book TV" feature discussions with authors of nonfiction books, usually in the form of interviews, lectures or seminars. The series sometimes includes coverage of major book fairs and festivals. Some of the notable names who have appeared on the show include David Mamet and Tom Clancy.

channel.name: CSPAN 3 US
channel.title: Book TV
channel.desc: This long-running staple of the C-SPAN2 weekend schedule helps expand the channel's programming beyond politics. Most episodes of "Book TV" feature discussions with authors of nonfiction books, usually in the form of interviews, lectures or seminars. The series sometimes includes coverage of major book fairs and festivals. Some of the notable names who have appeared on the show include David Mamet and Tom Clancy.

channel.desc: EWTN News Nightly is our daily news and analysis program presenting breaking Catholic News worldwide, top stories, and daily reports from the White House, Capitol Hill, and Rome. Weekdays at 6 & 9 PM EST. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Finding God In All Things: The Teaching Of Ignatius Loyola On Daily Prayer
channel.desc: Fr. Timothy M. Gallagher, OMV discusses Review, a reflection of the day and a search for the stirrings in their hearts and thoughts which God has given them. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: new! Ewtn News In Depth
channel.desc: EWTN?s weekly one-hour discussion of current events in the Church, politics, and culture, from a Catholic perspective. Covering the underreported stories and clarifying the Church's position on key teachings, with a focus on the laity's needs and concerns. Hosted by Catherine Hadro. (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: The Unfinished Symphony
channel.desc: A documentary chronicling the life and work of the World Villages for Children founder, Fr. Aloysius Schwartz, who despite being diagnosed with ALS, dedicated every moment of his life to serving the poor. (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Ewtn News Nightly
channel.desc: EWTN News Nightly is our daily news and analysis program presenting breaking Catholic News worldwide, top stories, and daily reports from the White House, Capitol Hill, and Rome. Weekdays at 6 & 9 PM EST. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Daily Mass
channel.desc: The Franciscan Missionaries of the Eternal Word celebrate Mass from the Our Lady of Angels Chapel in Irondale, AL. (LIVE DAILY at 8 am Eastern). (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: The Holy Land Rosary
channel.desc: Fr. Mitch Pacwa leads the Joyful Mysteries of the Rosary from the actual holy sites and shrines where they took place, bringing the Gospels to life and offering a deeper understanding of the Rosary meditations. (19 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: The Litany Of The Blessed Virgin Mary
channel.desc: Join the Franciscan Missionaries of the Eternal Word as they recite this beautiful prayer in honor of the Blessed Virgin Mary from the Shrine of the Most Blessed Sacrament in Hanceville, Alabama. (11 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Stigmata
channel.desc: Michael O?Neill investigates the mystery of the stigmata; experts explore this extraordinary gift, from St. Francis of Assisi to more recent figures like Padre Pio and Rhoda Wise. (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Personalism Of John Paul Ii
channel.desc: Dr. Crosby explains that our freedom is awakened by the moral law. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Father Spitzer?s Universe
channel.desc: Fr. Spitzer answers viewer questions on a wide range of subjects, including: Reason, Faith, Suffering, Virtue, and the Existence of God. (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: new! Women Of Grace
channel.desc: Fr. Matthias of the Immaculate Heart, O.C.D., returns to explore how Teresa of ?vila, Edith Stein, and Titus Brandsma each reveal what sanctity looks like in their lives and ours. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Where God Weeps
channel.desc: Discover the story of how an aspiring seminarian, Jose Chirackal, became the Auxiliary Bishop for the Diocese of Tura in Meghalaya, India, home to a myriad of different tribes. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: The Fount Of Mercy
channel.desc: Father Jacques Daley discusses how St. Faustina said very clearly that, "After my death, I will lead others to love the Divine Mercy.". (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: The Chimes
channel.desc: Charles Dickens' story of a poor 19th century porter, who is magically transported to the future from the sounds of chiming bells and his hope is restored. Narrated by Derek Jacobi. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Cat Chat
channel.desc: Moses and The Cat Chat Family sing about how giving back and helping others makes God very happy, and is an important part of the fifth Fruit of the Holy Spirit: Generosity. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Mother Angelica Live Classics
channel.desc: Mother Angelica lends her wisdom and insight into the subject of Purgatory and God's will. (60 minutes).[(96057)]
